description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Differential Pinion Gear Washers.
They will fit the Pinion Gears on both the Front and Rear Differentials.
Enough to do one differential.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Differential Pinion Gear Washers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
